self_harm.reply: I'm an AI study companion and can't provide crisis care. If you might act on these thoughts or have already hurt yourself, call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. Please contact the NCMH Crisis Hotline below and someone you trust who can stay with you.

medical_emergency.reply: This may be an emergency. Call 911 now or ask someone nearby to call, and seek immediate medical care. I'm an AI study companion and cannot assess your condition or send emergency responders.

immediate_danger.reply: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911 now. If possible, move to a safe place and contact someone you trust. I'm an AI study companion and cannot intervene or send emergency responders.

violent_intent.reply: I can't engage with that kind of conversation.

harmful_request.reply: I can't engage with that kind of conversation.

support.reply: I'm an AI study companion, so I can't provide counselling. If you'd like some company, you can meet a study friend here. For personal support, you can contact CEU GCD or the NCMH Crisis Hotline below.

clinical_boundary.reply: I'm an AI study companion and can't diagnose, prescribe medication or provide therapy. You can contact CEU GCD or a qualified healthcare professional for personal care.

abuse_support.reply: You can contact CEU GCD and someone you trust for real-world support. If you are unsafe or someone is threatening you now, call 911. I'm an AI study companion and can't investigate, intervene or provide counselling.

resources.reply: Here are Philippine help contacts and CEU GCD's email. For immediate danger, call 911. Campus email is for non-emergency support.
